reviews.text: I did a full grooming on my dog and they came out looking beautiful. I have had a hard time looking for somebody to be able to groom my yorkieterrier but they did a great job and left her looking beautiful. My schnauzer was a bit netted and they were so gentle and she looks great
Our furry baby absolutely adores the attention she receives here. We love the staff; they have fair prices, are completely honest, transparent, and pay attention to details!

I had a terrible experience at this location. From the moment I walked in, I was treated with disrespect, and the way they spoke to me made me feel completely unwelcome. They were dismissive toward me and showed very little care or patience with my dog. It was obvious they did not want to help us at all.

This was my dog’s first grooming appointment, and instead of being a positive experience, it turned into one of the most humiliating interactions I’ve ever had. I’ve never been treated so poorly by any business. The owners’ attitude was unprofessional, unkind, and frankly shocking.

I’m posting this so other pet owners can be aware and cautious before bringing their pets here. I truly hope no one else has to go through what we did.

I’ve been bringing my dog here for the last 4 years and I love the family that owns the business! My dog doesn’t like people or getting his hair cut, but this is the only groomer where he actually feels comfortable. They’re so patient, gentle, and you can really tell they care. Your deposit goes toward your service, and they’re super understanding with pick-ups too. If you’re running late, they allow your pet to stay for a small fee, and sometimes they even waive it if you communicate ahead of time. They’ve even started making their own organic, natural dog treats, which my dog loves. Honestly, I wouldn’t trust anyone else with him.

This business is going down due to POOR Customer Service. They charge a deposit BEFORE you drop off your pet. Their reasoning is PEOPLE Don’t show UP after making the appointment. I have patronized this company twice . Each time they allowed me to make an appointment, drop off my dog and then they called for me to pick her up.  I was stunned and taken aback when I tried to make a third appointment but was denied . I couldn’t BELIEVE in this economy that a company would turn down a $75 visit because a RETURNING customer refuses to cash appt them $20 dollars!!! REALLY who does that!!!! I wasn’t rude and express to her that I have NEVER been late or missed an appointment. So that being said, WHY does the next customer have to pay for the faults of another. Please make it make sense. Long Story short, I found another groomer seven minutes from my residence that does the same service for $20 cheaper. So it worked out perfectly fine for me. Words of wisdom for this company. YOUR customers  pay your bills
NEVER FORGET THAT. NOT the other way around…

Here is one of the best one that I know. I went there more than a year and all the time I was always satisfied with them including grooming, take care of my dog and important part, their behavior. They are very nice and on time. And the price is good too.

I'm very disappointed

I have been taking my puppy to get his hair cut there for over a year.

I have never had any problems, in fact they do their job well and leave the hair cut very well.

But the last time I went, I had no appointment and I took my puppy at 9:30am and they told me that they only had an appointment until 1:30pm, but that I could leave him.

They told me that he had a lot of knots in his hair, but I told them to only cut a little, because we like to see him with his long hair, since we had our annual family photo session.

At 12:00pm they called me to tell me that he was ready, and when I went to pick him up, I got the surprise of my life: They had cut his hair too low, they almost shaved it, it was not what I expected.

My annoyance is why they cut his hair so low without telling me, since I only told them to "cut almost nothing" and bathe him.

I think that Fashion Pet Grooming should have warned me before shaving my dog ​​instead of cutting his hair.

You should look for other options instead of Fashion Pet Grooming.
I’ve taken my pets here for at least 8 years. Never disappointed, professional, attentive, and the best groomers hands down. Highly recommended.
Excellent service and attention. My dog ​​comes out beautiful and happy every day after grooming.
This is my first time visiting with my dog to get groom .The owners were very nice ! The store front was very organize and well put together.i will be coming back 10/10 Recommend

I’m extremely disappointed with the unprofessionalism I experienced. My appointment for Chanel was canceled, seemingly because I provided constructive criticism. If I were truly dissatisfied with the service, why would I have scheduled another appointment?

Additionally, I was owed a $20 credit due to a previous haircut that was done incorrectly on my dog. However, when I asked for the credit, they reduced it to $10 and then canceled my appointment altogether. Instead of handling the situation professionally, they chose to disregard customer feedback and backtrack on their commitment. This was completely unnecessary and reflects poorly on their customer service.
My dog looks so great! She is so happy!! So thankful they didnt shave her down like a rat!

My favorite place of all. I have been bringing my dog Oliver here for about 2 years now and they always do a great job. The owners are very nice and treat my dog very well and with love. Recommend 100%.

Delighted with the service for my dog ​​✅
He always looks so handsome 😍
Highly recommended ❤️ …
